newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower, commercial selling late.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower, commercial selling late.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower, with commercial firms featured late sellers of March, traders said.
Volume was light. Cargill led by selling 1.5 million bushels of March.
Trading of the December/March spread was noted. The December/March spread traded both ways from 40 to 47 cents, premium December. It closed at 44 cents premium December.
Traders said some of the selling appeared to be in sympathy with lower CBOT soft red winter wheat futures.
KCBT wheat closed six to 2-1/2 cents lower, with December down 4-1/2 at $4.39-1/2 a bushel and March 5-3/4 lower at $3.95-1/2.
Trading closed at 1210 CST/1810 GMT Friday due to Thursday's U.S. Thanksgiving holiday. Normal trading hours, with a 1315 CST close, resume Monday.
